Maps a LicenseRef or AdditionRef string for a Custom License or a Custom License Addition to its URI ID.
**NOTE:** This property is deprecated and only included for backward compatibility. New documents should use [customIdToLicense](./customIdToLicense.md) instead.
EvidenceType refers to categories of documented or observable proof used to verify compliance, qualification, or performance

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: orcidid
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: [Open Researcher and Contributor ID (ORCID) iD](https://info.orcid.org/what-is-orcid/) is a unique identifier for authors and contributors in scholarly communication; as a subset of the International Standard Name Identifier (ISNI), it typically appears as a URI such as `https://orcid.org/0000-0002-1825-0097`.
Describes a sensor used for collecting the data.
Expression for the export control classification.
Specifies the CVSS qualitative severity rating of a vulnerability in relation to a piece of software.
A collection of Elements that have a shared context.
A test action is a specific action associated with a test.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: follows
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The `to` Element succeeds the `from` Element, establishing a unidirectional sequence. This succession is defined as chronological, procedural, or logical. It is used to represent either a temporal order (e.g., in a workflow) or a logical order for processing and traversal (e.g., in an ordered list).
Specifies the type of an external identifier.
Title of the project.
Provides the location of an external reference.
Provides an unambiguous mechanism for conveying a URI fragment portion of an Element ID.
Provide an enumerated set of lifecycle phases that can provide context to relationships.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: affects
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The `from` Vulnerability, Action or DefinedProcess affects each `to` Element.
Capture the scope of information about a specific relationship between elements.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: support
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The artifact has been released, and is supported from the supplier. There is a validUntilDate that can provide additional information about the duration of support.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: other
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A generic contact point to be used when the contact type does not match any of the other options.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: expandsTo
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The `from` Element expands out as an artifact described by each `to` Element.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: phoneNumber
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Phone number; A string of decimal digits that uniquely indicates the network termination point defined in [RFC 3966](https://datatracker.ietf.org/doc/rfc3966/) Section 5.
Date of product release.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: obsolete
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: superseded or not valid at present

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: hasHost
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The `from` Build was run on the `to` Element during a LifecycleScopeType period (e.g. the host that the build runs on).
Enumeration of dataset types.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: gtin
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: [Global Trade Item Number (GTIN)](https://www.gs1.org/standards/id-keys/gtin) is a number, assigned by GS1, that uniquely identifies a trade item (product or service).

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: verificationUUID
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The UUID used by a verification management system or any other lifecycle management tool to uniquely identify a verification item. UUID, or universally unique ID, is a standard term to refer to verification items.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: test
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Conducting controlled tests, experiments or simulations to verify that specific requirements regarding performance, functionality, robustness, etc. are met.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: ark
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: [Archival Resource Key (ARK)](https://arks.org/about/), is a Uniform Resource Identifier (URI) suited to being a persistent identifier for information objects of any type, standardized by the [ARK Identifier Scheme](https://datatracker.ietf.org/doc/draft-kunze-ark/) Internet-Draft. It consists of the "ark:" label followed by a Name Assigning Authority Number, a forward slash, a name, and an optional qualifier (e.g., `ark:12148/btv1b8449691v/f29`).
Provides an EPSS assessment for a vulnerability.
Commentary on an assertion that an annotator has made.
Provides a reference to a resource outside the scope of SPDX 3 content that uniquely identifies an Element.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: directDownload
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Dataset is publicly available and can be downloaded directly.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: hasExample
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Every `to` Element is an example for the `from` Element (`from` hasExample `to`).

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: track
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The vulnerability does not require action at this time. The organization would continue to track the vulnerability and reassess it if new information becomes available. CISA recommends remediating Track vulnerabilities within standard update timelines.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: report
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Structured documentation of test results, inspections, or analyses.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: bic
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Business Identifier Code (BIC), also known as SWIFT-BIC or SWIFT code, is a unique 8 or 11-character alphanumeric code standardized by [ISO 9362](https://www.iso.org/standard/84108.html) to identify financial and non-financial institutions (e.g., `BBWCUS33`).

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: design
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A relationship has specific context implications during an element's design.
verificationMethod refers to the specific approach used for a checking an element's conformance with its requirements.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: iswc
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: [International Standard Musical Work Code (ISWC)](https://www.iswc.org/iswc) is an 11-character unique identifier standardized by [ISO 15707](https://www.iso.org/standard/83125.html) for musical works (compositions) as distinct from specific recordings. While the "ISWC" label and grouping separators (dots and hyphens) are used for human readability, they shall be omitted when the identifier is stored electronically (e.g., `T0017812031`).
Street address includes a street number, name and unit ID to identify a specific street.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: other
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A relationship has other specific context information necessary to capture that the above set of enumerations does not handle.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: noAssertion
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: No assertion can be made about the completeness of the relationship.
Specifies the SSVC decision type.
The relative file name of a file to be excluded from the `PackageVerificationCode`.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: runsOn
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The `from` Element (the instructions) of runs on each `to` Hardware (processing element), during a LifecycleScopeType period.
The location for picking up a package or item.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: diskImage
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The Element refers to a disk image that can be written to a disk, booted in a VM, etc. A disk image typically contains most or all of the components necessary to boot, such as bootloaders, kernels, firmware, userspace, etc.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: releaseHistory
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A reference to a published list of releases for a package.
Additional relevance information.
Specifies an Extension characterization of some aspect of an Element.
Provides an IntegrityMethod with which the integrity of an Element can be asserted.
Specifies an Element contained in a piece of software where a vulnerability was found.
Gives information about the circumstances or unifying properties that Elements of the bundle have been assembled under.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: configures
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The `from` Element is a configuration applied to each `to` Element, during a LifecycleScopeType period.
Provides an ExternalMap of Element identifiers.
Sponsor of the project.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: hasMetadata
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Every `to` Element is metadata about the `from` Element (`from` hasMetadata `to`).

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: usesTool
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The `from` Element uses each `to` Element as a tool, during a LifecycleScopeType period.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: altWebPage
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A reference to an alternative web page.
The valid state for DefinedStateProcess.
Text specifying a province or state.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: regulation
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A mandatory legal specification issued by a governmental or regulatory authority. Compliance is enforceable by law.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: executable
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The Element is an Artifact that can be run on a computer.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: act
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The vulnerability requires attention from the organization's internal, supervisory-level and leadership-level individuals. Necessary actions include requesting assistance or information about the vulnerability, as well as publishing a notification either internally and/or externally. Typically, internal groups would meet to determine the overall response and then execute agreed upon actions. CISA recommends remediating Act vulnerabilities as soon as possible.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: build
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The element follows the Build profile specification.
Requirements can be categorized into various types based on their focus, purpose, and scope.
Describes the type of annotation.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: webpage
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Absolute URL that can be used to locate a resource, as defined in [RFC 7230](https://datatracker.ietf.org/doc/rfc7230/) Section 2.7.1 or Section 2.7.2.
The destruction process is defined in this process.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: update
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A relationship has specific context implications for a product update.
Property that describes the digest of the build configuration file used to invoke a build.
A code that identifies a county.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: sha512
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: SHA-2 with a digest length of 512, as defined in [RFC 6234](https://datatracker.ietf.org/doc/rfc6234/).

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: lexid
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: LEX Identifier is a Uniform Resource Name (URN) for sources of law within the [LEX namespace](https://www.iana.org/assignments/urn-formal/lex), as defined in [RFC 9676](https://datatracker.ietf.org/doc/rfc9676/) (e.g., `urn:lex:it:stato:decreto.legislativo:2018-08-10;101`).

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: archive
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The Element is an archived collection of one or more files (.tar, .zip, etc.).
Defines the beginning of a range.
Indicates whether a relationship is known to be complete, incomplete, or if no assertion is made with respect to relationship completeness.
Provides a place for the SPDX data creator to record acknowledgement text for a software Package, File or Snippet.
Provides information about the primary purpose of an Element.
The point in time when an element or an action starts, becomes applicable, or becomes valid.
Specifies whether a license or additional text identifier has been marked as deprecated.
Specifies the type of the content identifier.
Identifies an external Element used within an SpdxDocument but defined external to that SpdxDocument.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: runtime
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: SBOM generated through instrumenting the system running the software, to capture only components present in the system, as well as external call-outs or dynamically loaded components. In some contexts, this may also be referred to as an "Instrumented" or "Dynamic" SBOM.
Specifies until when the artifact can be used before its usage needs to be reassessed.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: framework
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The Element is a software framework.
An actual change to a product.
Authentication protocol used by a server.

rdf:Description.sh:message: https://spdx.org/rdf/3.1/terms/SupplyChain/CreateAction is an abstract class and should not be instantiated directly. Instantiate a subclass instead.

rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Specifies the time when a vulnerability was published.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: platform
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The Element represents a runtime environment.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: swhid
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: SoftWare Hash IDentifier, a persistent intrinsic identifier for digital artifacts, such as files, trees (also known as directories or folders), commits, and other objects typically found in version control systems. The format of the identifiers is defined in the [SWHID specification](https://www.swhid.org/swhid-specification/v1.2/) ([ISO/IEC 18670](https://www.iso.org/standard/89985.html)). They typically look like `swh:1:cnt:94a9ed024d3859793618152ea559a168bbcbb5e2`.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: hasDependencyManifest
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The `from` Element has manifest files that contain dependency information in each `to` Element.
A name used in a CdxPropertyEntry name-value pair.
Preprocessing steps applied to the training data before the model training.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: hasOptionalDependency
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The `from` Element optionally depends on each `to` Element, during a LifecycleScopeType period.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: log
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Time-stamped records capturing system or operational data recorded as usually as a response to specific triggers in a specified environment.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: runtimeAnalysisReport
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A reference to a runtime analysis report for a package.
EvaluationResultType describes the outcome of an evaluation or verification process with.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: isci
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: International Standard Collection Identifier (ISCI) is a variable-length identifier standardized by [ISO 27730](https://www.iso.org/standard/44293.html) for identifying collections held by libraries, archives, museums, and other memory institutions. It consists of two parts: the identifier for the assigning organization (an ISIL) enclosed in square brackets, followed by a local collection identifier string (e.g., `[FR-751041001]Casadesus1`).

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: implementedBy
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The `from` Requirement is implemented in the `to` Element(s).

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: bower
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A reference to a Bower package. The package locator format, looks like `package#version`, is defined in the "install" section of [Bower API documentation](https://bower.io/docs/api/#install).

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: functionalSafety
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The element follows the FunctionalSafety profile specification.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: finetunedOn
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The `from` Element has been finetuned on the `to` Element(s).

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: conformsTo
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The `from` Element conforms to each `to` Specification.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: reportedBy
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Designates a `from` Vulnerability was first reported to a project, vendor, or tracking database for formal identification by each `to` Agent.
A place for the SPDX document creator to record a website that serves as the package's home page.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: evidenceUUID
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The UUID used by a reporting management system or any other lifecycle management tool to uniquely identify an evidence relationship item. UUID, or universally unique ID, is a standard term to refer to evidence items.

rdf:Description.sh:message: https://spdx.org/rdf/3.1/terms/Security/VexVulnAssessmentRelationship is an abstract class and should not be instantiated directly. Instantiate a subclass instead.

rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Type of support that is associated with an artifact.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: socialMedia
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A reference to a social media channel for a package.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: securityOther
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Used when there is a security related identifier of unspecified type.
A canonical, unique, immutable identifier of the artifact content, that may be used for verifying its identity and/or integrity.

Provide the enumeration of possible decisions in the [Stakeholder-Specific Vulnerability Categorization (SSVC) decision tree](https://www.cisa.gov/stakeholder-specific-vulnerability-categorization-ssvc).
Specifies the level of support associated with an artifact.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: urlScheme
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: [Uniform Resource Identifier (URI) Schemes](https://www.iana.org/assignments/uri-schemes/uri-schemes.xhtml). The scheme used in order to locate a resource.

**DEPRECATED in SPDX 3.1.** Use [/Core/isoAutomationLevel](../../Core/Properties/isoAutomationLevel.md) instead.
Indicates whether the system can perform a decision or action without human involvement or guidance.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: hasTestCase
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Every `to` Element is a test case for the `from` Element (`from` hasTestCase `to`).
Provide consumers with comments by the creator of the Element about the Element.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: lei
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The [Legal Entity Identifier (LEI)](https://www.gleif.org/en/organizational-identity/introducing-the-legal-entity-identifier-lei) is a 20-character, alphanumeric code based on the [ISO 17442](https://www.iso.org/standard/78829.html) standard developed by the International Organization for Standardization.
Records the storage of a product.
Describes if a given file is a directory or non-directory kind of file.
Evaluation is an outcome considering results of a verification.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: hasTest
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Every `to` Element is a test artifact for the `from` Element (`from` hasTest `to`), during a LifecycleScopeType period.
VirtualHardwareModelType sets the VirtualHardware Model Type.
The point in time when an element or an action ends, becomes no longer applicable, or becomes no longer valid.
Information about the relationship between two Elements.
References an Element on the right-hand side of a relationship.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: trackStar
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: ("Track\*" in the SSVC spec) The vulnerability contains specific characteristics that may require closer monitoring for changes. CISA recommends remediating Track\* vulnerabilities within standard update timelines.
ISO level of automation.
Energy consumed when finetuning the AI model that is being used in the AI system.
References the Element on the left-hand side of a relationship.
